entities.name: PMID:25088333
observations: Retrospective cohort of 655 grade 1 endometrioid endometrial carcinomas; mucinous differentiation occurred in 137 (20.9%).
Stage IA distribution was similar with versus without mucinous differentiation (85.4% vs 86.3%).

Mucinous differentiation associated with more myometrial invasion (61.3% vs 51.5%; OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.01–2.19), but not significantly different PFS (98 vs 93.4 months; p=0.07). No adjusted recurrence/PFS model reported.

entities.name: Mucinous differentiation grade 1 EC
observations: In a retrospective cohort of grade 1 endometrioid endometrial carcinoma, mucinous differentiation was not associated with a higher FIGO stage distribution or statistically significant PFS disadvantage; adjusted recurrence effect remains uncertain.
